policyUpdates.howToTitle: How a new policy version is published
policyUpdates.howToIntro: Versions are not edited on this page. They live in the code, so a new version goes out with a deploy, and then you announce it here.
policyUpdates.howToStep1: An engineer edits the text and adds a new version to the document in LEGAL_POLICIES (version, dates, a short summary, and whether it is a material change). One pull request.
policyUpdates.howToStep2: Merge it, and deploy the marketing site and the API. The new version then appears in the list below.
policyUpdates.howToStep3: If the version is material, press Send notice on its row the same day. Every store owner gets an email and a banner until they press Got it. It can be sent once per version.
policyUpdates.howToNotMaterial: A version that is not marked material has no Send notice button, by design: merchants are not told about typo and formatting fixes. To announce one, mark it material in the code and deploy again.
